name: dev
description: Plan-driven software development with MCP-backed local-agent delegation: set up, explore, plan, execute, and review.
shortDescription: Set up, explore, plan, delegate, execute, and review software changes.
longDescription: Dev packages four plan-driven development skills: dev-setup initializes or aligns a project with the owner's baseline practices, dev-explore maps the codebase and converges on a direction, dev-write-plan turns that direction into an outcome contract under wiki/plans/, and dev-execute-plan implements the plan with MCP-backed delegation to local coding agents before verifying the result.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-setup to initialize this project with my baseline practices.
Use dev-explore to understand this codebase and converge on an approach.
Use dev-execute-plan to implement a TODO plan and delegate independent work to local agents.
